_README: Regression corpus — governance mechanism (e).
A fixed set of defect cases with EXPERT-ADJUDICATED expected tiers,
re-run whenever the ontology, controlled vocabularies, rules, or the
extraction engine change. A changed prescription must be explained and
signed off before the knowledge base is released.
THIS FILE SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE.
The expected tier of a case is an engineering adjudication, not a
value the software can supply for itself. Seeding it from whatever the
knowledge base currently returns would make the corpus a tautology: it
would pass by construction and detect nothing. Each case must be
adjudicated by a reviewer and recorded here with their name.
COVERAGE THAT ACTUALLY DETECTS REGRESSIONS
Boundary cases carry the diagnostic load. For every numeric threshold,
include one case below it, one at it, and one above it — those are what
catch a silently altered comparison operator or limit. A corpus of
typical cases confirms no gross breakage but rarely finds anything.
Also include: one case per FMEA chain; one of each conflict type
(severity, extent, cause); one ambiguous identity match that must route
to adjudication rather than merge; and one whose measurement interval
straddles a threshold and must resolve to Investigation_Required.
